public_body: Nahant Open Space And Recreation Master Plan Committee (Nosrmpc)
overall: The AG found the Nahant Open Space and Recreation Master Plan Committee is a public body not covered by the Connelly exception, and that it violated the OML by failing to post notice and keep minutes for meetings from September 2015 to February 2016.

allegations.summary: Town Counsel argued the committee was created by the Town Administrator under Connelly and so was not a public body subject to the Open Meeting Law.
allegations.key_passage: We find that the Master Plan Committee is a public body of the Town, not of the Town Administrator, and therefore the Connelly exception does not apply.

allegations.summary: The complaint alleged the committee failed to post notice of its meetings, including meetings from September 2015 through February 2016.
allegations.key_passage: Where the Master Plan Committee failed to post notice of its meetings held between September 2015 and February 2016 and failed to maintain minutes of those meetings, it violated the Open Meeting Law.

allegations.summary: The complaint alleged the committee failed to keep meeting minutes; the committee kept minutes only for its October 14, 2015 meeting.
allegations.key_passage: and failed to maintain minutes of those meetings, it violated the Open Meeting Law

remedy: Immediate and future compliance with the law's notice and minutes requirements.
Create minutes for all previous meetings to the best of its ability, using whatever means are available, within sixty days of receipt of the letter.
remedy_passage: We order the Master Plan Committee to create minutes for all preyious meetings to the best of its ability, through whatever means are available, including the memories and individual notations of the attendees.
